fixed_requirements: Side-wall grab bar: continuous L-shape, 750 mm horizontal + 750 mm vertical components; vertical component 150 mm in front of the water closet (3.8.3.8.(3)(a)/(5)).
All grab bars: resist 1.3 kN, diameter 30-40 mm, wall clearance 38-50 mm, slip-resistant (3.8.3.8.(7)).
Fold-down grab bar on the transfer side: at least 750 mm long, 390-410 mm from the water closet centreline, pull-down force not more than 22.2 N (3.8.3.8.(8)).
Stall door: self-closing, D-pulls both sides at 800-1,000 mm, latch releasable from outside in an emergency (3.8.3.8.(1)(c)).
Universal washroom door: power door operator required; emergency call system with audible and visual devices inside and outside (3.8.3.12).
Ambulatory stall where required: 890-940 mm wide, at least 1,500 mm deep, door clear opening at least 810 mm (3.8.3.8.(10)).
Accessible urinal: rim not more than 430 mm above floor, clear floor space at least 800 mm wide (3.8.3.10).
edition_changes_2024: No fixed 1,500 x 1,500 mm stall size in 2024 — replaced by turning-space and clearance rules.
Stall door clear opening is now 850 mm (was 810 mm).
Seat height is now 430-485 mm (was 400-460 mm).
Universal washroom turning space is now 1,700 mm diameter (was 1,500 mm).
source: OBC 2024 Articles 3.8.3.8-3.8.3.12, verified at ontario.ca 2024 Building Code Compendium Part 3, 2026-11-15
